# aardio Windows Automation MCP Bridge
**English** | 简体中文
> **Overview**: Encapsulate the full capabilities of **aardio**—the lightweight, zero-install, nativ
e Windows development language—into standard **HTTP RPC** and **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** proto

cols.
> Enables any AI Agent, LLM client, or automation script to seamlessly access native Windows W
in32 APIs, GUI automation, high-precision mouse/keyboard control, screenshot/color-picker capabiliti
es, and 1000+ aardio standard libraries without overhead.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## ✨ Features
- 🚀 **Zero Setup & Standalone**: Pre-compiled as a single native Win32 executable (`rpc-server.exe`,

~3MB). No heavyweight runtimes, SDKs, or installations required.
- 🔄 **On-Demand Cold Start & Self-
Healing**: The MCP Bridge automatically detects service health. If the server is offline or terminat
ed, it starts silently in < 0.5s and retries seamlessly. Zero background memory footprint when not i

n use.
- ⚡ **Turing-Complete Dynamic Eval**: The `/api/eval` endpoint dynamically runs arbitrary aar
dio scripts at runtime, granting AI immediate access to 1000+ Win32, COM, WMI, GDI+, and cryptograph

ic libraries.
- 🖱️ **Full Computer Use Primitives**: Precise absolute mouse coordinate control, left
/right/double clicks, scrolling, drag-and-drop, keyboard hotkeys/combinations, and multi-monitor scr

een capture.
- 🔌 **Universal Agent Compatibility**: Tested with DeepSeek Harness (DSH), Claude Deskt

op, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LibreChat, and standard MCP clients.
- 🛑 **Complete Lifecycle Con
trol**: Includes the `server_stop` tool, allowing AI to shut down background processes and free reso
urces once automation tasks are finished.

## 🛠️ MCP Tools Reference (22 Tools)
| Tool Name | Category | Description |

| `list_endpoints` | Meta | Dynamically inspect all 50+ available RPC endpoints at runtime |
| `call

_endpoint` | Meta | Generic caller for any RPC endpoint without modifying bridge code |
| `eval` | C

ore | Execute arbitrary aardio expressions; access all 1000+ Win32/COM libraries |
| `server_stop` |

Lifecycle | Stop background server to free memory; automatically relaunches on next tool call |
| `
clipboard_read` / `clipboard_write` | Clipboard | Read from or write text to the Windows system clip

board |
| `exec` / `exec_bg` | Shell | Synchronous or non-blocking command execution returning outpu

t or PID |
| `screenshot` | Vision | Capture full screen or active window to an image file |
| `mous
e_pos` / `mouse_move` / `mouse_click` / `mouse_scroll` | Computer Use | Cursor positioning, click si

mulation (left/right/double), wheel scroll |
| `keyboard` | Input | Send keystrokes, hotkeys (`Ctrl+

C`, `F7`), or type arbitrary text strings |
| `window_list` / `window_topmost` | Windows | Enumerate

all desktop window handles/titles and toggle topmost status |
| `process_list` / `process_kill` | P

rocesses | Query running processes sorted by RAM/CPU/PID, and terminate processes |
| `find_files` |

Filesystem | High-performance wildcard and recursive file scanner |
| `http_get` / `weather` / `sql
ite_query` | Utilities | Native HTTP proxy, weather queries, and direct SQLite query execution |
> Detailed endpoint documentation is available in `docs/AARDIO-BRIDGE.md` and architectural theory i
n `docs/CORE-BOOTSTRAP-SPEC.md`.
## ⚙️ Compilation & Development

To modify source code or add custom low-level endpoints:
1. Download the free, portable aardio IDE (

~6.5MB).
2. Open `projects/00-rpc-server/default.aproj`.
3. Edit `main.aardio` (core endpoints) or `

ext-tools.aardio` (extension endpoints).
4. Press **F7** inside the IDE to publish a fresh `dist/rpc

-server.exe`.
